name: CodecSplat
aliases: Ultra-compact latent coding framework for feed-forward 3D Gaussian splatting
definition: CodecSplat is an ultra-compact latent coding framework for feed-forward 3D Gaussian splatting that encodes an intermediate 2D Gaussian-generation feature into an entropy-coded scene bitstream, avoiding compression of irregular 3D Gaussian primitives.
summary: CodecSplat is a compression framework for feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting that encodes structured intermediate features into ultra-compact bitstreams, avoiding inefficient compression of irregular 3D primitives.
